description:
Title: Find a Job

You have to regularly report, to which companies you wrote job applications.
Based on your job applications, new potential job offers are sent to you.
Companies have to confirm that they received job applications and rate the application.
A job interview can be negotiated.
When a company wants you to work for them, you enter the probation phase.
After probation phase, you can rate the company and the company can rate you.
Reviews for a company can only be seen (by job applicants) after 1 year.
If a job becomes permanent, the process ends, unless you rated the company C or less, then you continue to receive job offers, but no longer have to report.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/find-a-job">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_JobApplication" name="Job application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ApplicationReport" name="Report of companies applied to"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ApplicationFeedback" name="Application confirmation and rating"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PotentialOffer" name="Potential job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_HiringDecision" name="Hiring decision"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ApplicantRating" name="Company rating of applicant"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PermanentStatus" name="Job permanence status"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Find a Job — Applicant" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Applicant_Start" name="Start job search"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Applicant_Apply" name="Write and send job applications" messageRef="Message_JobApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Applicant_Report" name="Report companies applied to" messageRef="Message_ApplicationReport"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Applicant_ReceiveFeedback" name="Receive application confirmation and rating" messageRef="Message_ApplicationFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Applicant_ReceiveOffer" name="Receive potential job offer" messageRef="Message_PotentialOffer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Applicant_InterviewGateway" name="Is a job interview negotiated?" default="Applicant_NoInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Applicant_InterviewYes" name="Interview negotiated" sourceRef="Applicant_InterviewGateway" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveDecision">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">interviewNegotiated</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Applicant_NoInterview" name="No interview negotiated" sourceRef="Applicant_InterviewGateway" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveDecision"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Applicant_ReceiveDecision" name="Receive hiring decision" messageRef="Message_HiringDecision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Applicant_HiringGateway" name="Does the company want you to work for them?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Applicant_Probation" name="Enter probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Applicant_RateCompany" name="Rate company"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Applicant_ReviewSplit" name="Continue and start review visibility timer"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Applicant_OneYearTimer" name="One year after company rating">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="Applicant_OneYearTimerDefinition">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Applicant_ReviewVisible" name="Company review becomes visible to job applicants"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Applicant_ReceiveApplicantRating" name="Receive company rating of you" messageRef="Message_ApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Applicant_ReceivePermanentStatus" name="Receive job permanence status" messageRef="Message_PermanentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Applicant_PermanentGateway" name="Did the job become permanent?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Applicant_CompanyRatingGateway" name="Did you rate the company C or less?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Applicant_PermanentEnd" name="Job became permanent; process ends"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Applicant_OfferContinueMerge" name="Continue receiving potential job offers"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Applicant_NotSelectedEnd" name="Company does not want you to work for them"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Applicant_Flow_1" sourceRef="Applicant_Start" targetRef="Applicant_Apply"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Applicant_Flow_2" sourceRef="Applicant_Apply" targetRef="Applicant_Report"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Applicant_Flow_3" sourceRef="Applicant_Report" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Applicant_Flow_4" sourceRef="Applicant_ReceiveFeedback" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Applicant_Flow_5" sourceRef="Applicant_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Applicant_InterviewGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Applicant_Flow_6" sourceRef="Applicant_ReceiveDecision" targetRef="Applicant_HiringGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Applicant_Flow_7" name="Company wants you" sourceRef="Applicant_HiringGateway" targetRef="Applicant_Probation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyWantsApplicant</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Applicant_Flow_8" name="Company does not want you" sourceRef="Applicant_HiringGateway" targetRef="Applicant_NotSelectedEnd">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not companyWantsApplicant</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Applicant_Flow_9" sourceRef="Applicant_Probation" targetRef="Applicant_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Applicant_Flow_10" sourceRef="Applicant_RateCompany" targetRef="Applicant_ReviewSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Applicant_Flow_11" sourceRef="Applicant_ReviewSplit" targetRef="Applicant_OneYearTimer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Applicant_Flow_12" sourceRef="Applicant_OneYearTimer" targetRef="Applicant_ReviewVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Applicant_Flow_13" sourceRef="Applicant_ReviewSplit" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Applicant_Flow_14" sourceRef="Applicant_ReceiveApplicantRating" targetRef="Applicant_ReceivePermanentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Applicant_Flow_15" sourceRef="Applicant_ReceivePermanentStatus" targetRef="Applicant_PermanentGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Applicant_Flow_16" name="Job became permanent" sourceRef="Applicant_PermanentGateway" targetRef="Applicant_CompanyRatingGateway">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">jobIsPermanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Applicant_Flow_17" name="Job did not become permanent" sourceRef="Applicant_PermanentGateway" targetRef="Applicant_OfferContinueMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not jobIsPermanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Applicant_Flow_18" name="Rated C or less; no further reporting" sourceRef="Applicant_CompanyRatingGateway" targetRef="Applicant_OfferContinueMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyRatingIsCOrLess</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Applicant_Flow_19" name="Rated above C" sourceRef="Applicant_CompanyRatingGateway" targetRef="Applicant_PermanentEnd">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyRatingIsAboveC</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Applicant_Flow_20" sourceRef="Applicant_OfferContinueMerge" targetRef="Applicant_Report"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company — Application and employment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Company_ApplicationReceived" name="Job application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Company_ApplicationMessageDefinition" messageRef="Message_JobApplication"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Company_ConfirmReceipt" name="Confirm receipt of application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Company_RateApplication" name="Rate application"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Company_SendFeedback" name="Send application confirmation and rating" messageRef="Message_ApplicationFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Company_SendOffer" name="Send potential job offer" messageRef="Message_PotentialOffer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Company_InterviewGateway" name="Is a job interview negotiated?" default="Company_NoInterview"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Company_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate a job interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Company_InterviewMerge" name="Continue after interview decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Company_HiringGateway" name="Does the company want the applicant to work for it?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Company_SendPositiveDecision" name="Send decision: wants applicant" messageRef="Message_HiringDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Company_SendNegativeDecision" name="Send decision: does not want applicant" messageRef="Message_HiringDecision"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Company_Probation" name="Enter probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Company_RateApplicant" name="Rate applicant"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Company_SendApplicantRating" name="Send company rating of applicant" messageRef="Message_ApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Company_PermanentGateway" name="Did the job become permanent?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Company_SendPermanentStatus" name="Send status: job became permanent" messageRef="Message_PermanentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Company_SendNonPermanentStatus" name="Send status: job did not become permanent" messageRef="Message_PermanentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Company_NotSelectedEnd" name="Applicant not selected"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Company_PermanentEnd" name="Job became permanent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Company_NotPermanentEnd" name="Job did not become permanent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_1" sourceRef="Company_ApplicationReceived" targetRef="Company_ConfirmReceipt"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_2" sourceRef="Company_ConfirmReceipt" targetRef="Company_RateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_3" sourceRef="Company_RateApplication" targetRef="Company_SendFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_4" sourceRef="Company_SendFeedback" targetRef="Company_SendOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_5" sourceRef="Company_SendOffer" targetRef="Company_InterviewGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_InterviewYes" name="Interview negotiated" sourceRef="Company_InterviewGateway" targetRef="Company_NegotiateInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">interviewNegotiated</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_NoInterview" name="No interview negotiated" sourceRef="Company_InterviewGateway" targetRef="Company_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_6" sourceRef="Company_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Company_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_7" sourceRef="Company_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Company_HiringGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_8" name="Company wants applicant" sourceRef="Company_HiringGateway" targetRef="Company_SendPositiveDecision">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyWantsApplicant</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_9" name="Company does not want applicant" sourceRef="Company_HiringGateway" targetRef="Company_SendNegativeDecision">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not companyWantsApplicant</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_10" sourceRef="Company_SendPositiveDecision" targetRef="Company_Probation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_11" sourceRef="Company_SendNegativeDecision" targetRef="Company_NotSelectedEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_12" sourceRef="Company_Probation" targetRef="Company_RateApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_13" sourceRef="Company_RateApplicant" targetRef="Company_SendApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_14" sourceRef="Company_SendApplicantRating" targetRef="Company_PermanentGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_15" name="Job became permanent" sourceRef="Company_PermanentGateway" targetRef="Company_SendPermanentStatus">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">jobIsPermanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_16" name="Job did not become permanent" sourceRef="Company_PermanentGateway" targetRef="Company_SendNonPermanentStatus">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not jobIsPermanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_17" sourceRef="Company_SendPermanentStatus" targetRef="Company_PermanentEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Company_Flow_18" sourceRef="Company_SendNonPermanentStatus" targetRef="Company_NotPermanentEnd"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindAJob" name="Find a Job">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ReportRecipient" name="Recipient of application reports"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" name="Job application" sourceRef="Applicant_Apply" targetRef="Company_ApplicationReceived" messageRef="Message_JobApplication"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Report" name="Report of companies applied to" sourceRef="Applicant_Report" targetRef="Participant_ReportRecipient" messageRef="Message_ApplicationReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Application confirmation and rating" sourceRef="Company_SendFeedback" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveFeedback" messageRef="Message_ApplicationFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" name="Potential job offer" sourceRef="Company_SendOffer" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveOffer" messageRef="Message_PotentialOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PositiveDecision" name="Hiring decision" sourceRef="Company_SendPositiveDecision" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveDecision" messageRef="Message_HiringDecision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NegativeDecision" name="Hiring decision" sourceRef="Company_SendNegativeDecision" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveDecision" messageRef="Message_HiringDecision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ApplicantRating" name="Company rating of applicant" sourceRef="Company_SendApplicantRating" targetRef="Applicant_ReceiveApplicantRating" messageRef="Message_ApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PermanentStatus" name="Job became permanent" sourceRef="Company_SendPermanentStatus" targetRef="Applicant_ReceivePermanentStatus" messageRef="Message_PermanentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NonPermanentStatus" name="Job did not become permanent" sourceRef="Company_SendNonPermanentStatus" targetRef="Applicant_ReceivePermanentStatus" messageRef="Message_PermanentStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
